title: Event Frequency Distribution
insights:
Dataset Summary

Total Events: 44,031

Total Users: 499

Event Types: 80

Date Range: December 24, 2025 - January 20, 2026

Event Frequency Distribution Analysis

DOMINANT PATTERNS

The following events dominate user interactions within the app:

  • _user: 3,959 events (8.99%)
  • _location_special-town-search: 2,847 events (6.47%)
  • Buslist_date change: 2,806 events (6.37%)
  • _location_elastic-town-search: 2,149 events (4.88%)
  • _bus-search_user-bus-search: 1,592 events (3.62%)
  • _location_from-town: 1,560 events (3.54%)
  • _bus-search_list: 1,478 events (3.36%)
  • _rewards_best-V2: 1,431 events (3.25%)
  • bus_search: 1,429 events (3.25%)
  • bus_result: 1,426 events (3.24%)

This distribution indicates that users primarily engage with searching for buses and related functionalities, such as changing dates and selecting locations. The high frequency of the _user event suggests that user identification or session tracking is a critical aspect of the app's functionality.

EVENT NOISE

There are no events that appear suspiciously often, indicating no clear logging bugs. However, events with very low counts may indicate broken features. Events with counts below 10 should be investigated for potential deprecation.

POWER USERS

The analysis of user engagement reveals the following:

  • Median Event Count: 56
  • P90 Event Count: 148
  • P99 Event Count: 720
  • Maximum Event Count: 1,921
  • Users above 200 events: 34

Power users (P90+) exhibit significantly higher engagement compared to casual users, with the P99 users showing a maximum event count of 1,921, indicating a strong stickiness to the app among the most engaged users.

CONSOLIDATION

There are several events related to bus searching and selection that could be consolidated for clarity and efficiency:

  • _bus-search_user-bus-search
  • bus_search
  • _bus-search_list

Consolidating these events could streamline data analysis and improve understanding of user interactions related to bus searching functionalities.
